title: Equal degree and type do not determine a code-loop representation
scope: Two actual rank-seven full-support reduced doubly-even binary subspaces on Fin50, each with sorted type fifteen ones/seven fives, represent the SAME explicitly nonassociative Moufang loop by genuine source-sign multiplicative bijections, but no arbitrary Fin50 coordinate permutation carries one code to the other. Refutes the broad printed2019Conjecture1, with all factor, weight, quotient-type, sign, rank and transport bridges included.
